adoption.validation_script:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1')
test=repo/'build-wasm/src/tests/aot/test_aot_wasm.js'
def run(name,args):
    with (root/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(args,cwd=repo,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    print('PASS',name,flush=True)
run('adopted-probes',['node',str(test),'--emit-memory-probes'])
def probes(name):
    return [json.loads(line[13:]) for line in (root/(name+'-probes.log')).read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('MEMORY_PROBE ')]
base,trial,adopted=[probes(n) for n in ['baseline','candidate','adopted']]
assert len(base)==len(trial)==len(adopted)==56
for a,b,c in zip(base,trial,adopted):
    expected=a if c['mode']==0 else b
    assert c==expected,(c['name'],c['mode'])
print('PASS byte identity: 28 TLB modules equal baseline; 28 direct modules equal timed candidate',flush=True)
run('adopted-counts',['node',str(repo/'src/tests/wasm/span-counts.mjs'),str(root/'baseline-probes.log'),str(root/'adopted-probes.log'),str(root/'adopted-counts.json')])
for name,selector in [('shared-spans','--shared-spans-only'),('memory','--memory-implementations-only'),('arm-memory','--arm-memory-only'),('loop-budget','--loop-budget-only')]:
    run('adopted-'+name,['node',str(test),selector])
out=root/'adopted-build';out.mkdir()
for name in ['eka2l1.wasm','eka2l1.js','eka2l1.html','eka2l1.data','audio.js','audio-worklet.js']:
    shutil.copy2(repo/'build-wasm/src/emu/wasm'/name,out/name)
(root/'adopted-hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in out.iterdir()},indent=2))
args=json.loads((root/'replays-command.json').read_text())
args[2]=str(root/'adopted-replays');args[args.index('--build')+1]=str(out)
(root/'adopted-replays-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(args,indent=2))
run('adopted-replays',args)
adoption.limitation: CPU timings are for the combined trial; final direct-only restriction has repeated count, focused and native replay validation, but no separate CPU campaign.
